schema:
CREATE TABLE "categories" ("cat_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "label" TEXT(100), "tier" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE "products" ("prod_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "cat_id" INTEGER, "label" TEXT(100), "tier" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("cat_id") REFERENCES "categories" ("cat_id"));
correct_query: SELECT "tier_other" AS "tier" FROM (SELECT "LHS"."cat_id" AS "cat_id", "LHS"."label" AS "label", "LHS"."tier" AS "tier", "RHS"."prod_id" AS "prod_id", "RHS"."label" AS "label_other", "RHS"."tier" AS "tier_other" FROM (SELECT * FROM "categories" WHERE ("label" = 'Books' OR "label" = 'Games')) AS LHS INNER JOIN products AS RHS ON (LHS.cat_id = RHS.cat_id)) ORDER BY tier
